samples.question: Four pip-labeled lamps start as shown (filled = ON, ring = OFF). Read cards 1 through 8 from left to right. A triangular FLIP card toggles the lamp named by its 1-4 pips. A square SAVE card replaces the saved snapshot with the current four-lamp pattern. A circular RESTORE card replaces the current pattern with the most recently saved snapshot; before card 1, that snapshot equals the starting pattern. After all cards, how many lamps are ON? Answer 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4.
